stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - Krieg in der Ukraine: Russland trifft Schule in Kiew sowie ukrainischen Kampfjet

en.title: LIVE TICKER - War in Ukraine: Russia hits school in Kyiv and Ukrainian fighter jet
en.summary: Russia continues its military operations against Ukraine, which have been ongoing for over four years. Key developments in the conflict are being tracked in this live update.

stories.title: JO 2038: Après bientôt 80 ans sans Jeux olympiques d’hiver, le National ouvre la voie à une candidature suisse

en.title: 2038 Olympics: After nearly 80 years without Winter Games, the National Council opens the way for a Swiss bid
en.summary: Switzerland's National Council approved federal funding of 200 million francs for a potential 2038 Winter Olympics bid, waiving a referendum requirement. Switzerland has not hosted the Winter Games since 1948.

stories.title: Angriff auf Flydubai-Flug: Benjamin Netanyahu hat seinen Helden

en.title: Attack on Flydubai flight: Benjamin Netanyahu has his hero
en.summary: A man removed an alleged attacker from an aircraft cockpit, preventing a threat to approximately 180 passengers. The incident has become a focus for political commentary regarding the Prime Minister.

stories.title: Dans le Chablais, les cantons de Vaud et du Valais se réconcilient sur la troisième correction du Rhône

en.title: In Chablais, the cantons of Vaud and Valais reconcile on the third Rhône correction
en.summary: After two years of disputes, the environment ministers of Vaud and Valais reached a compromise on the third Rhône correction project in Chablais, valued at 368 million francs. The project will now proceed to public inquiry.

stories.title: Le Conseil national soutient l'organisation des Jeux olympiques d'hiver 2038 en Suisse

en.title: National Council supports organization of 2038 Winter Olympics in Switzerland
en.summary: Switzerland's National Council has expressed support for hosting the 2038 Winter Olympic Games in the country.

stories.title: Le cas Christa Pike, un énième «ratage» cruel dans les couloirs de la mort aux Etats-Unis

en.title: The Christa Pike case, yet another cruel failure in U.S. death row
en.summary: A woman sentenced to death in 1996 survived two lethal injections in Tennessee, exposing repeated execution failures in the United States.

stories.title: Pandemie der Einsamkeit: Jeder Dritte über 65 Jahre sehnt sich nach mehr Gemeinschaft

en.title: Loneliness pandemic: One in three people over 65 yearns for more community
en.summary: More than one-third of people aged 65 and older report wanting greater social connection, a problem worsened by declining community organizations and social groups.

stories.title: Krieg in der Ukraine – Drohneneinschläge auf der Südbrücke über den Fluss Dnjepr in Kiew

en.title: War in Ukraine – drone strikes on southern bridge over Dnieper River in Kyiv
en.summary: Two Russian drones struck the supports of a southern bridge crossing the Dnieper River in Kyiv, triggering a fire.

stories.title: Le volet chablaisien de la troisième correction du Rhône mis à l'enquête

en.title: The Chablais section of the third Rhône correction put to public inquiry
en.summary: A major component of the third Rhône correction project affecting the Chablais region has reached a public inquiry stage. The project aims to strengthen flood protection across 14 kilometers of the region.

stories.title: Kulturnews in Kurzform – Greta Thunberg am Zurich Film Festival: Saal blieb fast leer

en.title: Culture news in brief – Greta Thunberg at Zurich Film Festival: hall nearly empty
en.summary: An event with climate activist Greta Thunberg at the Zurich Film Festival attracted very few attendees despite being sold out. It remains unclear whether this was an intentional action.

stories.title: Greta Thunberg says Morocco sabotaged Western Sahara debate in Zurich

en.title: Greta Thunberg says Morocco sabotaged Western Sahara debate in Zurich
en.summary: A debate featuring climate activist Greta Thunberg at the Zurich Film Festival had 300 tickets sold but only 40 attendees. Thunberg attributes the low turnout to Morocco's alleged interference.

stories.title: Vorfall auf Flydubai-Flug – Netanjahu und Modi würdigen angegriffenen Piloten als Helden

en.title: Incident on Flydubai flight – Netanyahu and Modi praise attacked pilot as hero
en.summary: Following an incident on a flight to Tel Aviv, Israel's prime minister and India's premier commended the pilot for their actions.

stories.title: Rohstoffskandal landet bei der Schweizer Justiz: US-Investor reicht Strafanzeige gegen Radiant World ein

en.title: Commodities scandal reaches Swiss justice: US investor files criminal complaint against Radiant World
en.summary: A New York financial firm has reported a loss of 49 million dollars and suspects Radiant World of fraud. Commodity giant Glencore also conducted business with the controversial company.

stories.title: Die Flugsicherheit rückt wieder in den Fokus: die wirtschaftlichen Folgen der Beinahe-Katastrophe bei Flydubai

en.title: Flight safety back in focus: economic consequences of near-catastrophe at Flydubai
en.summary: A violent incident on a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv has disrupted air traffic, causing Israel to temporarily lose a key route. Airlines now face pressure to improve crew screening procedures.

stories.title: Donald Trump kündigt Milliardeninvestitionen Südkoreas an

en.title: Donald Trump announces South Korean billion-dollar investments
en.summary: The US President describes plans including a power plant, eight nuclear reactors, and a gas pipeline. South Korea has downplayed the announcement, but the pattern shows allied nations paying substantially for lower tariffs and security commitments.

stories.title: «Geht zum Teufel, wir wollen euch nicht!»: Warum sind die Amerikaner so wütend auf die KI-Rechenzentren? Eine Spurensuche in Texas

en.title: "Go to Hell, We Don't Want You!": Why Are Americans So Angry About AI Data Centers? An Investigation in Texas
en.summary: Opposition to AI data centers is growing across the United States, including in business-friendly Texas. Local resistance is prompting political action ahead of midterm elections.

stories.title: MELDUNGEN WIRTSCHAFT - Die Schweizer Jahresinflation erreicht ein Prozent +++ Mercedes-Benz reaktiviert Abfindungsprogramm in Deutschland

en.title: ECONOMIC REPORTS - Swiss annual inflation reaches one percent +++ Mercedes-Benz reactivates severance program in Germany
en.summary: Swiss annual inflation has reached one percent. Mercedes-Benz is reactivating a severance package program for its German workforce.
